title.narrative: In 2024, UNICEF Ecuador made significant progress by implementing the advocacy strategyPrimeroLaInfancia, which seeks to position children as a national priority. It also developed advocacy and communication strategies on key issues, such as the impact of violence on children and chronic malnutrition in children.;
